titulo: Quiz — the minute at the desk
subtitulo: Έχετε for what they have, μπορώ να for what you want to do
introPt: A traveller checks in before the room is ready, improves it in two sentences, and reports one thing that has stopped.
cenario: Hotel reception, late morning, the room not ready until two.

dialogo.es: Καλημέρα, έχω κράτηση. Έχετε ένα πιο ήσυχο δωμάτιο;
dialogo.pt: Good morning, I have a booking. Do you have a quieter room?
dialogo.tts: Καλημέρα, έχω κράτηση. Έχετε ένα πιο ήσυχο δωμάτιο;

dialogo.es: Έχω ένα στον τρίτο, προς την αυλή. Θα είναι έτοιμο στις δύο.
dialogo.pt: I have one on the third floor, facing the courtyard. It'll be ready at two.
dialogo.tts: Έχω ένα στον τρίτο, προς την αυλή. Θα είναι έτοιμο στις δύο.

dialogo.es: Τέλεια. Μπορώ να αφήσω τη βαλίτσα εδώ;
dialogo.pt: Perfect. Can I leave my suitcase here?
dialogo.tts: Τέλεια. Μπορώ να αφήσω τη βαλίτσα εδώ;

dialogo.es: Βεβαίως, αφήστε την πίσω από τον πάγκο.
dialogo.pt: Of course, leave it behind the counter.
dialogo.tts: Βεβαίως, αφήστε την πίσω από τον πάγκο.

perguntas.pergunta: What did the desk actually answer with?
opcoes: A floor and a side of the building
perguntas.explica: Στον τρίτο, προς την αυλή. Third floor, courtyard side — the detail is the yes.

perguntas.pergunta: Which opening asks whether an action of yours is allowed?
perguntas.explica: Μπορώ να αφήσω, μπορώ να φύγω αργότερα. Έχετε asks what the other person has.

perguntas.pergunta: When is a quieter room or a later departure cheapest to ask for?
opcoes: At check-in, while the booking is still on the screen
By email once you are home
perguntas.explica: The same request is one keystroke at the desk and needs a reason attached once you have the key.

perguntas.pergunta: The air conditioning has stopped. What is the sentence?
perguntas.explica: Name the object, add δεν δουλεύει. For water and light it is δεν έχει: δεν έχει ζεστό νερό.

perguntas.pergunta: A hotel bill of five hundred euros or more has to be paid how?
opcoes: In cash, so the receipt is issued
By card, transfer or another electronic means
Half in cash, half by card
perguntas.explica: The cash ceiling for a consumer bill is €500, down from €1,500. The total is what crosses the line, not each night.
